scenarioCoverage.name: Real integrated source path
scenarioCoverage.expectation: - **WHEN** isolated real producer/runner/CLI code receives complete current fixture authority, accounting and both claim owners - **THEN** it commits exactly one debit before one stubbed child call through the actual caller, with independently recomputable output and no live writes.

scenarioCoverage.name: Missing instance evidence
scenarioCoverage.expectation: - **WHEN** a concrete grant, canonical anchor/history, observation or final executor is absent - **THEN** the source emits a named unavailable result before financial debit/launch; only the expressly authorized read-only preflight below may obtain a missing funding observation. Deterministic source repair/testing may proceed without inventing instance values.

requirementContexts.requirement: Authenticated context discovery and closed evidence payloads

scenarioCoverage.name: Actual CLI discovers an anchored valid fixture
scenarioCoverage.expectation: - **WHEN** isolated real cmd_run follows binding → amendment → projection/context/votes and validates the closed canonical store/history records and matching mutable correspondence - **THEN** it supplies that exact anchor and reconciled lineage to the real history reader and proceeds to the remaining guarded checks, rather than always returning unavailable or accepting an override.

scenarioCoverage.name: Unbound context or seeded evidence
scenarioCoverage.expectation: - **WHEN** an anchor/history/observer receipt is supplied outside the committed context, a resource vote binds another context, canonical-store event mapping is absent, a receipt is caller-fabricated or any closed payload has missing/extra fields - **THEN** admission rejects; a new unrelated store event or self-asserted observed balance cannot establish authority.

scenarioCoverage.name: Funding observation without a circular grant dependency
scenarioCoverage.expectation: - **WHEN** exact source/resource votes authorize G/N including one 125-second read-only preflight, but current funding is not yet observed - **THEN** only that charged exclusive preflight may run; its successful current receipt can satisfy later funding admission, while failure consumes its allowance without starting or charging financial attempt 3.

requirementContexts.requirement: Closed existing accounting fields and bounded successor semantics

scenarioCoverage.name: New grant only
scenarioCoverage.expectation: - **WHEN** a reviewed concrete successor closes all historical credit, preserves unknowns and supplies an exact enforceable active MC02 projection - **THEN** spendable credit is at most the new grant minus its actual committed usage, with old limits/counters preserved as history and no lifetime-global total claim.

scenarioCoverage.name: Shape-valid fabricated credit
scenarioCoverage.expectation: - **WHEN** the input omits external charges, guesses unknown costs, relabels package ownership, lacks the exact projection disposition, repeats an amendment, uses missing votes or presents invalid numeric/extra top-level fields - **THEN** the actual producer/consumer rejects before debit or launch, even if the old reader alone would accept its shape.

requirementContexts.requirement: Authenticated MC02 envelope on the preserved MC01 master

scenarioCoverage.name: Preserved master with active MC02 quota
scenarioCoverage.expectation: - **WHEN** isolated actual producer/reader code authenticates the exact MC02 projection and votes, reserves G, then transfers c into a current-envelope external charge - **THEN** MC01 owner/rows/counters remain unchanged, master used stays U+C+G, MC02 remaining equals G-c, aggregate dispatch increases once, and only this authenticated active quota governs the MC02 action.

scenarioCoverage.name: Projection arithmetic or authority mismatch
scenarioCoverage.expectation: - **WHEN** selected owner/scope, predecessor digest, votes, G/N/C/D, historical disposition, reserve-transfer identity, recomputed S/n or unchanged predecessor fields disagree - **THEN** current-resource validation rejects without live debit/launch or borrowing from old credit, even if top-level JSON shape is valid.

requirementContexts.requirement: Single allocation, all-kind limits and prepaid boundary

scenarioCoverage.name: Last authorized resource race
scenarioCoverage.expectation: - **WHEN** two real isolated callers compete for one remaining dispatch or the same final seconds - **THEN** existing lock/store serialization lets at most one commit and launch; both kind-switch and duplicated allocation paths reject.

scenarioCoverage.name: Own prepaid equality and post-reservation recheck
scenarioCoverage.expectation: - **WHEN** the exact c-second debit makes S=G or n=N and the CLI rechecks after claiming its own identical reservation but before the master launch transition - **THEN** A=G-S+c covers exactly c once and final remainder G-S is nonnegative; that own invocation passes resource validation while another reservation, changed charge or completed launch is denied.

requirementContexts.requirement: Master projection and global one-shot claim

scenarioCoverage.name: Persistence and claim crash matrix
scenarioCoverage.expectation: - **WHEN** isolated fault injection interrupts before debit, after debit before projection, between file replacements, between SQLite/master claim, or after master claim before child launch - **THEN** no unauthorized child starts; committed charges remain consumed, correspondence/claim disagreement denies, and an unlaunched committed invocation receives an explicit failed/unknown disposition without retry credit.

scenarioCoverage.name: Store rollback or clone replay
scenarioCoverage.expectation: - **WHEN** an already committed debit is presented with another clone/default-resolved store, a new/fallback store, a restored same-token pre-claim backup or conflicting ownership - **THEN** canonical identity and master one-shot claim deny another launch while preserving the existing SQLite guard and historical charge.

requirementContexts.requirement: Exact attempts and actual submission consumer

scenarioCoverage.name: Retry and attempt accounting
scenarioCoverage.expectation: - **WHEN** four allowed submissions are consumed or attempt 3 commits then fails before launch - **THEN** a fifth submission, counter reset, reservation-path switch or fourth invocation is denied and every real transaction/failed attempt remains retained.

requirementContexts.requirement: Independently bound observer launch and resource identities

scenarioCoverage.expectation: - **WHEN** an action of any supported program carries all mandatory evidence under that bound policy - **THEN** actual acceptance checks contract, intent, transition, history, and ledger-consumption predicates before applying effects.

scenarioCoverage.name: Downgrade attack
scenarioCoverage.expectation: - **WHEN** an action omits claims, strips mandatory roots, selects arbitrary verifiers, or supplies stale certificates, false guards, or unsatisfied dependencies - **THEN** actual acceptance rejects it before applying effects.

scenarioCoverage.name: Authorized route choice
scenarioCoverage.expectation: - **WHEN** different permitted plans refine the same signed outcome intent - **THEN** each successfully fulfilled route satisfies the original gross authority limits, net goals, and complete-effect relation; any accepted partial or failed outcome satisfies its signed failure policy and all applicable authority and complete-effect bounds.

scenarioCoverage.name: Ledger-valid intent-invalid action
scenarioCoverage.expectation: - **WHEN** a ledger-valid action has wrong recipients, refunds hiding excess gross debit, fees violating the applicable signed success or failure bounds, or undeclared approvals - **THEN** the mandatory refinement relation rejects it in actual acceptance.

scenarioCoverage.name: Bound outcome claims
scenarioCoverage.expectation: - **WHEN** a participant signs an outcome intent before a concrete execution is selected - **THEN** the signature binds the canonical constraints, program/profile/policy and required claims; the proof statement binds that authorization digest, concrete predecessors, observations, resulting state and complete effects, proves refinement, and matches the actual ledger projection.

scenarioCoverage.name: Bound exact-plan claims
scenarioCoverage.expectation: - **WHEN** a participant signs an exact plan - **THEN** acceptance additionally checks the signed canonical execution-body commitment against the concrete execution; the commitment excludes self-referential proof/signature bytes.

scenarioCoverage.name: Fake compliance
scenarioCoverage.expectation: - **WHEN** an action supplies hash-linked receipts, mock proofs, signatures alone, or unchecked certificate labels - **THEN** actual acceptance rejects the missing correctness evidence.

scenarioCoverage.name: Audited result
scenarioCoverage.expectation: - **WHEN** deterministic checks pass and both independent reviewers have no unresolved blocking finding - **THEN** the package records accepted scope with the exact reviewed candidate digest.

scenarioCoverage.name: Missing or stale audit
scenarioCoverage.expectation: - **WHEN** a reviewer required by the current maintainer delivery assignment is unavailable, substituted, stale, or lacks a substantive identity-bound verdict - **THEN** the internal delivery record remains pending audit; developer compilation, proving and deployment SHALL NOT reject solely for that missing review.

scenarioCoverage.name: Negative control incorrectly accepts

scenarioCoverage.name: Reviewed extension executes

scenarioCoverage.name: Fixed proof substituted for extension

scenarioCoverage.name: Changed semantic domain

scenarioCoverage.heading: Positive and hostile witnesses
scenarioCoverage.expectation:
Accept an unregistered solver's compatible route exchanging 10 A for at least 20 B at the signed recipient, with a fee no greater than 1 A within the aggregate 11-A debit cap. Accept an alternative route allowed by the same constraints. Preserve explicit obligations when settlement spans stages.

Reject independently mutated extra fee legs, changed recipients or fee denominations, conflicting settlement domains, substituted policy circuits, prohibited disclosure, and silently dropped residual duties, even when transaction balance and cryptographic proofs otherwise pass. Distinguish an incomplete candidate from a committed prefix. Prevent incompatible settle/refund branches consuming the same entitlement.
